verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents CI/CD experiments specifically to "block deploys on regressions." Teams run experiments in the CI/CD pipeline to catch quality regressions before they ship, using a GitHub Actions workflow built on the official langfuse/experiment-action. These experiments run against datasets with the SDK `run_experiment` function and code or LLM-as-a-judge evaluators. missing for 10: no detail on how pass/fail thresholds actually fail the CI job, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI gating.
